prompt: Write lyrics for a fusion song combining classical Indian and electronic music.
response:
(Verse 1)  
In the twilight’s gentle sigh,  
Beneath the monsoon sky, we fly.  
Sitar strings and synth collide,  
In our hearts, two worlds abide.  

Mystic chords, in waves, arise,  
From ancient lands to starry skies.  
Tabla beats to bass, entwined,  
In every note, a dream defined.  

(Chorus)  
O Saanjh, O twilight, blend the light,  
With neon beams, oh dance so bright.  
Harmony in chaos, peace in the wild,  
Sing, O heart, the song of the cosmic child.  

(Verse 2)  
Digital drops, like rain, they fall,  
On sacred rivers, through the sprawl.  
Ragas meet the rhythmic loops,  
In the dance, our spirit swoops.  

Veils of silk and circuit mesh,  
In this fusion, souls refresh.  
Echoes of the ancient call,  
In the pulse of the future’s thrall.  

(Chorus)  
O Saanjh, O twilight, blend the light,  
With neon beams, oh dance so bright.  
Harmony in chaos, peace in the wild,  
Sing, O heart, the song of the cosmic child.  

(Bridge)  
Flow through the ages, glide through the night,  
Behind the shadows, beyond the light.  
From the Ganges to the stars that we chart,  
Hear the universe beat in the rhythm of our hearts.  

(Verse 3)  
Flares of alap in the dark, spark,  
To the beats of the club's heart, hark.  
Melodies in electric veins,  
Tradition thrives and still remains.  

(Chorus)  
O Saanjh, O twilight, blend the light,  
With neon beams, oh dance so bright.  
Harmony in chaos, peace in the wild,  
Sing, O heart, the song of the cosmic child.  

(Outro)  
In the sync of time, in the blend of sound,  
Where the past and future are unbound,  
Together we rise, on this journey embarked,  
In the infinite play, where light meets the dark.
